page.overview:
What is Port Besaid?

Port Besaid, also known simply as Besaid, is a town located in the Besaid Region of Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is first visited in Chapter 18, "The Fell Spell and the Quacho Queen" and is the starting location of Chapter 19, "The Other Nine Wood Hills".

At the beginning of Chapter 19, "The Other Nine Wood Hills", a stairway of light is created and connects to the Nonary Region above.
